Discrepancies: bulk_discount_percent incorrectly returns 5% for quantity ≥ 50; parse_coupon is case‑sensitive whereas spec requires case-insensitivity; Cart.remove_item leaves zero-quantity entries instead of deleting them; Cart.subtotal applies discount incorrectly – e.g., 10×$1 gives $9.50 instead of $9.55.
All other functions and methods meet the specification.
